{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id values
print("Total rows:", len(df))
print("Unique patient_id:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Duplicate patient_id count:", len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check which patient_ids are duplicated and how many times
duplicates = df['patient_id'].value_counts() > 1
print("Duplicated patient_ids:\n", duplicates[duplicates].index.tolist())

# Check sample_seq for duplicated patients to see if they have multiple entries
duplicated_rows = df[df['patient_id'].isin(duplicates[duplicates].index)]
duplicated_rows_sorted = duplicated_rows.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'])
print("\nSample_seq for duplicated patients:\n", duplicated_rows_sorted[['patient_id', 'sample_seq']])"}
